attribution.title: Online Retail II
attribution.creator: Daqing Chen
attribution.citation: Chen, D. (2012). Online Retail II [Dataset]. UCI Machine Learning Repository. https://doi.org/10.24432/C5CG6D
modifications: lines copied across the two worksheets are counted once; repeated identical lines within one worksheet are kept
cancellation lines, lines with a quantity of zero or less, and lines whose stock code is not a product code are dropped
quantities are summed per stock code and trading date over the trading calendar, the dates with at least one transaction
each series starts at its first trading date with positive demand
the subset is a deterministic selection described in docs/validation.md
